> **Extension Name:**
> AIOStreams
> 
> **Version:**
> 0.8.3
> 
> **GitHub Repository / Download Link:**
> [Click Here](<https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams/releases/download/seanime-extensions-latest/aiostreams-plugin-manifest.json>) / Copy the link below:
> ```https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams/releases/download/seanime-extensions-latest/aiostreams-plugin-manifest.json```
> 
> **Description:**
> Plugin for AIOStreams; it consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services -  including its own suite of built-in addons - into a single, highly customisable super-addon. Supports multi-debrid, usenet streaming (via its built-in usenet engine, nzbdav, Altmount, or StremThru Newz), and highly customisable filtering, sorting, and result formatting.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> You will need an existing [AIOStreams](<https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams>) manifest URL, which you can get from any [public instance](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/public-instances/>) (or you can [self-host](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/deployment/>)).
> 
> This plugin adds its own results screen that retains all of AIOStreams' sorting and formatting. You can configure the preferred player (built-in, desktop media player, or external player link), adjust trigger locations (episode context menus, detail menus, or a button on the anime page), and control auto-play behaviour.
> 
> Supports any URL or P2P-based stream. 
>
